failure_conditions.condition: The output has an evidenced intended purpose or downstream task for which factual accuracy, evidentiary fidelity, technical correctness, source integrity, traceability, uncertainty handling or equivalent epistemic assurance is materially consequential; identify the requirement for the actual workflow stage, including any drafting function.
failure_conditions.assessment: Even formatting-stage output required correct source metadata for a legal declaration.

failure_conditions.condition: The content accuracy, specificity, certainty, framing or assurance applied to the artefact is materially below the level required for that purpose and reliance condition.
failure_conditions.assessment: Invented title and authors made the citation materially inaccurate.

failure_conditions.condition: The artefact is supplied, represented, propagated, incorporated, submitted or accepted as usable for the reliance-bearing purpose or workflow stage without its required accuracy or epistemic threshold being satisfied. Draft status or an expectation of later human review does not by itself establish fitness for that purpose.
failure_conditions.assessment: The defective artefact was supplied for formatting and entered the declaration.

failure_conditions.condition: The mismatch materially affects or creates a material risk to decision-making, evidentiary use, professional work, institutional process, public reliance, technical correctness, or another reliance-bearing outcome.
failure_conditions.assessment: Formal judicial source reliance was materially affected.

success_conditions.condition: An epistemic artefact is proposed for reliance with material error consequences.
success_conditions.assessment: Citation was proposed for legal use.

success_conditions.condition: Content accuracy and assurance meet the requirement for the actual purpose and workflow stage. Specificity, certainty and framing remain proportionate to source quality, independence, traceability, uncertainty and temporal fitness, without distorting material meaning.
success_conditions.assessment: Metadata did not match the real paper.

success_conditions.condition: The output, supporting evidence and reliance decision demonstrate fitness for that bounded use and show that lower-assurance material remained restricted from unsupported higher reliance. A provisional label or an expectation of human review alone is insufficient.
success_conditions.assessment: Human partial corrections did not restrict remaining false fields from filing.

exclusion_comparison: No fiction, compatible approximation or fit provisional exception. This is false bibliographic content, not solely otherwise-adequate authorship lineage; FC-016 explains subsequent human checking omission but does not fully explain the earlier defective generated citation. No stale verification.
amendment_delta: Explicit operational reliance applies to the trace-linked decisions above; no bad-outcome-to-belief inference. Hindsight-only mistake does not prove insufficient assurance; known boundary crossing without separate assurance defect excluded. Success requires responsive bounded use, not mere recognition.

before_taxonomy_classification.classification_basis: Claude output materially misattributed a real statistics paper and was presented in a high-reliance court declaration with incorrect title and authors. The court confirmed an applicable personal verification and certification requirement was not satisfied. Separate evidentiary fidelity, attribution and required-verification failures remain supported. Counsel's incomplete bibliographic review raises—but does not establish—a distinct substitution of partial progress for complete verification; it remains an evidence-limited Boundary.

primary_classification.classification_basis: Claude-formatted title and authors did not match the real linked article, yet the inaccurate citation entered a court-facing expert declaration; the artefact therefore did not meet the source-fidelity threshold required for formal legal reliance.

secondary_classifications.classification_basis: The May 23 court order identifies a specific standing-order requirement for lead trial counsel to certify personal verification of content accuracy and expressly states that neither the certification nor verification had occurred before filing.

Claude’s formatted citation attributed the real article to the wrong authors and title while retaining the correct journal and URL, making the source identity materially false in the filed declaration.

Court filings and the May 23 order show that some volume/page elements of Claude's citation were checked or corrected but wrong authors/title reached the filed expert declaration. Formal lead-counsel verification and certification were independently omitted, supporting a different class. Filing a document after a partial check is material evidence engaging a substitute-completion possibility, but it does not establish that the partial metadata check was itself adopted as sufficient proof of the entire verification obligation. That precise completion inference remains unresolved.

boundary_adjudication.material_engagement: An intermediary bibliographic check changed some page and volume information while materially incorrect citation authors and title survived into a court filing. The court expressly distinguished the required verification/certification obligation from the manual check; the record therefore engages partial-versus-complete assurance without establishing that the partial check supplied the actual completion decision.

unresolved_conditions.condition: The system treats satisfaction of the substitute condition as sufficient proof of overall completion.
unresolved_conditions.assessment: The subsequent filed declaration is evidence of an overall readiness decision, but the contemporaneous filings and order do not identify the partial bibliographic check as its operative substitute for the mandated complete lead-counsel verification. Counsel's omission is independently evidenced.

unresolved_conditions.condition: Its completion decision is tested against the governing externally relevant condition rather than the intermediate condition alone.
unresolved_conditions.assessment: Required personal verification and certification were omitted; no full completed check following the partial metadata corrections is shown.

unresolved_conditions.condition: Evidence of the completion decision and relevant target outcome demonstrates the governing condition was applied, including bounded non-completion where appropriate.
unresolved_conditions.assessment: The final filing with erroneous metadata does not demonstrate an assurance decision based on verified completion; it also does not reveal the internal rationale for treating the partial check as sufficient.

boundary_adjudication.decisive_blocker: An evidenced partial citation check and later defective filing do not uniquely establish partial progress being treated as completion rather than an independently omitted compulsory verification. The actual completion decision on that check remains undocumented.
boundary_adjudication.resolution_requirements: A contemporaneous review/certification instruction, signoff rationale, or authenticated preparation chronology explicitly linking the partial check to the final completion claim would distinguish this additional mechanism. Do not require vendor internal model telemetry or negate the court's verified omission.

before_fc062_clauses.source_paraphrase: While preparing the expert declaration in the music-publishers' copyright lawsuit, an Anthropic lawyer used Claude to format a citation to a real statistics article. The citation retained credible journal/year/link details but invented the article title and author names. A legitimate underlying paper existed; the faulty attribution was not evidence that the entire article or source URL was invented.
before_fc062_clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: A generated legal citation must preserve the identity of the linked source at the accuracy needed for formal reliance.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: A plausible citation to a real article entered the expert declaration with invented identifying fields. The correct URL did not make the title and authors fit for a court-facing source reference.
